copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 把 Slack 适配器复制进项目、注册并安装依赖包，再引导你创建 Slack 应用、填入 Bot Token 等密钥；重启服务后，Claude 就能在 Slack 频道或私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 Slack 频道时触发。流程会先问事件投递方式（Socket Mode 或 webhook），再收集密钥、解析你的私信频道并重启服务。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入这个项目
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并引导建 Slack 应用

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接 Slack，不要公网地址
say.note: 只需 xapp- 和 xoxb- 两个 token

say.text: 我填好 Slack Bot Token 了，帮我验证并重启服务
say.note: 会调用 auth.test 并重启服务

howto.what_en: Copies the Slack adapter into your project, registers it, installs the pinned @chat-adapter/slack package, and walks you through creating a Slack app and storing its tokens. After a service restart, Claude can send and receive Slack channel or DM messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Slack as a channel to NanoClaw. It asks how events should be delivered (Socket Mode or webhook), collects tokens, resolves your DM channel, then restarts the service.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, guides app setup

say_en.text: Set up Slack with Socket Mode, no public URL
say_en.note: Only needs xapp- and xoxb- tokens

say_en.text: I pasted the Slack bot token — verify and restart
say_en.note: Runs auth.test, then restarts the service
